title: feat(deburr): picked and excluded edges, minimum edge angle, hole filter
body:
## What changed

The 3D `Deburr` operation has four new controls.

- **Picked edges.** When the source is a selection with edge chains, the operation breaks only the exposed edges on those chains. A whole model, the stock, or a selection with no edge chain keeps the automatic detection.
- **Excluded edges.** `exclude_edges` is a list of edge chains. The exposed edges on these chains stay sharp.
- **Minimum edge angle.** `min_edge_angle_deg` removes each convex crease whose face normals bend less than the value. A new operation gets 40 degrees.
- **Hole filter.** `exclude_holes`, `hole_min_diameter` and `hole_max_diameter` remove the rims of recognized round holes (`drilling::recognize`, `recognize_cross`) whose diameter is in the range.

Where the code is:

- `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/deburr_filter.rs` (new): the edge filters and their notes. `finishing3d::deburr_edges` takes the picked and the excluded chains. `deburr` calls it with no chains.
- `crates/app/src/operation/deburr_picks.rs` (new): resolves the picked and the excluded chains from the world.
- `OpParams::Deburr`, `sane.rs`, the seed, the stamp digest, the project DTO: the five new fields.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/deburr_page.rs` (new): the rows on the Deburr Geometry tab, and the button "Exclude the picked edges".

Each skipped group of edges gives a note on the toolpath. A picked chain that names no rim and no convex crease is refused by name: a vertical cone over a concave corner cuts the two faces. An excluded chain that is no longer in the model is refused by name.

## Cause

Before this change, the Deburr kernel rode each rim and each convex crease of the mesh. The operation ignored its picks: a Deburr with a selection source rode every edge of the picked models. There was no angle limit, so the facet seams of a smooth convex surface were ridden as edges.

## Decisions (`docs/decisions/1888-deburr-edge-filters.md`)

- The issue says to remove Deburr from the `!selection_drives_region` guard. I did not do that. That guard makes a 2D area from the picks and refuses an open chain. The picks are read as paths, the same as Multi-Axis Contour drive chains. The result is the behaviour that the issue asks for.
- A project file without `min_edge_angle_deg` reads 0 (every crease). That is the path the file stored. The seed for a new operation is 40. Each new key is absent from the file at its rest value, and the stamp digests a filter only off its rest value. An old automatic or face-only operation keeps its cached path unchanged. A chain-selected operation must regenerate once. Its stamp versions the changed selection behavior.
- The minimum angle and the hole filter apply to the automatic edge set only. A pick is an explicit instruction.
- A face, patch or vertex pick in the source keeps its old meaning: it names the model that the operation reads. `turned_selected_deburr_cuts_like_the_baked_part` (#2284) pins that reading. The first version of this branch refused a face pick, and the quick gate failed on that test. Only an edge chain narrows the ride.
- No new command: the new fields are operation parameters. `EditOperationParams` (UI Apply, MCP `edit_operation`) and `SetOperationGeometry` (MCP `set_operation_geometry`) carry them. No MCP follow-up issue is necessary.

## Tests (pins, mutation results)

Motion, `crates/motion/tests/deburr_filters.rs` (new, 7 tests):

- `a_crease_below_the_minimum_edge_angle_is_skipped_out_loud`
- `a_picked_chain_rides_alone`
- `a_pick_that_names_no_exposed_edge_refuses_by_name`
- `an_excluded_chain_is_left_out_of_the_automatic_edges`
- `a_hole_rim_inside_the_diameter_range_is_skipped`
- `a_cross_hole_rim_inside_the_diameter_range_is_skipped`
- `the_filter_doors_refuse_by_name`

App, `crates/app/tests/deburr_edge_filters.rs` (new, 8 tests):

- `a_picked_edge_is_the_only_edge_broken`
- `a_face_pick_names_the_model_and_keeps_the_automatic_ride`
- `an_excluded_pick_that_is_gone_is_refused_by_name`
- `an_excluded_edge_stays_sharp`
- `the_minimum_edge_angle_reaches_the_kernel`
- `a_hole_inside_the_diameter_range_keeps_its_rim`
- `the_command_door_refuses_a_bad_filter`
- `the_filters_round_trip_the_project_file`

App, `crates/app/tests/mcp_deburr.rs` (new): `deburr_takes_edge_chains_and_its_filters_through_mcp`.

Changed tests: `the_deburr_seed_carries_the_heights_and_a_hand_break_width` asserts the seed values. The UI tab table in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs` names the new Geometry rows. Six test files that build `OpParams::Deburr` by hand got the new fields at their rest values.

Red before the fix: yes. The first pin did not compile on unchanged code, because the API did not exist (`gate test a_picked_chain_rides_alone`: `FAIL compile error`).

Mutations. Each one disabled one guard, and the named pin went red. The guard was then restored and the pin went green.

| Guard disabled | Pin | Result |
|---|---|---|
| minimum angle test | `a_crease_below_the_minimum_edge_angle_is_skipped_out_loud` | red |
| pick narrows the ride | `a_picked_chain_rides_alone` | red |
| exclusion | `an_excluded_chain_is_left_out_of_the_automatic_edges` | red |
| hole filter | `a_hole_rim_inside_the_diameter_range_is_skipped` | red |
| hole diameter range | `a_hole_rim_inside_the_diameter_range_is_skipped` | red |
| cross holes read | `a_cross_hole_rim_inside_the_diameter_range_is_skipped` | red |
| cross hole span sign | `a_cross_hole_rim_inside_the_diameter_range_is_skipped` | red |
| refusal of a pick with no exposed edge | `a_pick_that_names_no_exposed_edge_refuses_by_name` | red |
| angle door in the kernel | `the_filter_doors_refuse_by_name` | red |
| non-finite chain door | `the_filter_doors_refuse_by_name` | red |

| app passes the excluded chains | `an_excluded_edge_stays_sharp` | red |
| app passes the angle | `the_minimum_edge_angle_reaches_the_kernel` | red |
| app passes the hole filter | `a_hole_inside_the_diameter_range_keeps_its_rim` | red |
| only chain picks are read as edges | `a_face_pick_names_the_model_and_keeps_the_automatic_ride` | red |
| refusal of a chain that is gone | `an_excluded_pick_that_is_gone_is_refused_by_name` | red |
| `sane.rs` door | `the_command_door_refuses_a_bad_filter` | red |

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green on head `2617560cf` (291 steps, 0 failed). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean. An earlier run on this branch had one failure, `turned_selected_deburr_cuts_like_the_baked_part`. The face-pick decision above is its fix.

## Deburr Geometry screenshots

These captures render the actual shell UI meshes and textures on the CPU. The viewport is blank because Metal supplies no graphics adapter.

Before: the original Geometry rows, with only the break width control.

![Deburr Geometry before the change](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/ff2cec170d626b09167f6616843f5e3c575ca765/2688/deburr-geometry-before.png)

After: the enabled hole filter shows the diameter fields. The excluded-edge list contains Edge 4 of Block.

![Deburr Geometry after the change](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/ff2cec170d626b09167f6616843f5e3c575ca765/2688/deburr-geometry-after.png)

The images are stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.

## Goldens moved

None. `git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` is empty.

## Not exercised

- The UI rows were not operated by hand. The tab table test proves that the rows are drawn. No test clicks "Exclude the picked edges".
- A stepped hole (counterbore, chamfered mouth). Recognition reports the narrow bore. The rim of the wider ring is not on that cylinder and stays in the ride.
- A picked chain under a part alignment (`setup_align`) or a WCS yaw. The chains use the same pose and the same yaw slot as Multi-Axis Contour drive chains; no test of this PR runs that path for a Deburr. The MCP test has no mutation of its own: it runs the existing `edit_operation` and `set_operation_geometry` tools on the new fields.
- A rename of a model that `exclude_edges` names. Generation then refuses by name ("which is gone"). Exclusion model movement, geometry changes and deletion now have cache invalidation tests.
- The release tier and the pixel snapshots. This PR changes no snapshot PNG. The Deburr Geometry tab has new rows, so a snapshot of that tab changes at the cut.

## Behaviour change to know

A Deburr whose stored source has edge chains now breaks only those edges. Before, it rode every edge of the picked models. A source of faces only is unchanged.

## Overlaps

- #1713 (`gap_link`, `needs-rework`) touches the same files (`generate.rs`, `kinds.rs`, `types/params.rs`, `project/params.rs`, `params_impl.rs`, `finishing3d/mod.rs`), different functions (the Finish3D arms). The PR that merges second refreshes.
- #2149 (`needs-rework`), #2666 and #2675 touch `generate.rs`, different functions. The PR that merges second refreshes.
- #2660 changed `drilling/recognize.rs` and merged during this work. This branch has a merge of that main, and the hole filter reads the `CrossHole` travel sign of #2601.

Effort: high (no escalation)

Changelog: 3D Deburr: pick the edges to break or to exclude, set a minimum edge angle (40 degrees for a new operation), and skip round holes inside a diameter range.

Fixes #1888
